answer: The handling option (A/B/C) and the marker choice are exactly the two Open Ambiguities; task is status: blocked with no option selected, so implementation cannot start until the owner picks one.
Marker choice is the second Open Ambiguities item. Case/substring/exact-status detection semantics are sub-details that only need resolving once the owner selects a marker.
Precedence between a frontmatter `record: true` and a title/`## Status` match is undefined, but only matters if mixed markers exist. Make frontmatter authoritative and note it in the closeout.

No issue model exists: spec/artifacts/ has no issue.yaml, deskops/models defines no IssueDoc, and spec/fields/ has no record.yaml. These drawer files are unmodeled prose docs, so `record: true` needs no SLDB field contract.

The path scanner is `_explicit_source_file_declarations` (deskops/graph/extract_edges.py:338), invoked for kind in {task,issue} at extract_edges.py:93, using SOURCE_PATH_RE (extract_edges.py:25) via `_paths_in_line` (extract_edges.py:352).
Only the two drawer files get marked, so no documents outside desk/drawer/ are in scope now; the general rule is detection, not marking. Executor can state this in the closeout.

to_dict() filters only None (deskops/graph/checks.py:28-30), so a `record: bool = False` field is emitted and would break the exact-dict asserts at tests/test_graph_checks.py:25 and :64. `graph missing` has no --json (cli/parser.py:327-329); test_graph_cli.py asserts text only.

Format is mostly fixed (separate `Informational (archived records):` heading, `N missing, M informational` summary, exit 1 iff a non-record finding exists). Column layout, ordering, full-text repetition, and N=0/M=0 rendering stay executor choices.

Kind and locator are unchanged: kind is set in `_finding_from_missing_target` (checks.py:73-82) to `missing_declared_target` unless the target is an atom, and the record-path locator stays `line:N:source-file-reference` (extract_edges.py:338-350).
Already stated: Implementation Path says option A 'instead skips those edges there', i.e. record edges are not emitted at extraction. No separate missing-report-only path is contemplated.

Option B contradicts Goal ('no per-file allowlist'), Implementation Path (mark both files; test a marked record) and Done When ('both new tests pass'), and has no exit-code rule. Fix: drop B or make Goal/Done When/tests option-specific and define B's exit code.

The live-drawer-task fixture is unspecified; the natural choice is a tmp_path desk/drawer/tasks/*.md created inside the new test in tests/test_graph_declared_edges.py, which already has a `write` helper.
Premise is a checked-at-HEAD claim; the task says list new non-record findings in closeout but not whether the task still passes. Executor should record them and let the supervisor decide acceptance.
Already resolved: Resolved Decisions states the supervisor makes the closeout commit and that closing always requires `pytest tests` green in addition to the task Done When.
